revisions: OpenHands R7 full chain journal was reduced to a fixed-size rolling WAL: one committed-prefix candidate + one pending-event candidate + exact-save payload. The design remains crash-recoverable in the modeled domain while bounding marker growth to O(base snapshot size).

OpenHands exact hook seam moved down to EventLog's serialized pre-write boundary reached only from ConversationState.append_event, so the marker binds the final post-hook event identity and exact event JSON while preserving direct fork EventLog.append behavior when the callback is absent.

R7 cleanup failure handling was strengthened: a finalized same-generation WAL may be cleanup-retried only if raw base exactly matches the final digest; a finalized marker with old base blocks new appends and cannot be repurposed.

rmcp custom call_tool is no longer the preferred seam. Keeping #[tool_handler]'s generated router-first call_tool lets ToolRouter disablement and standard typed extractors run before a registered task-capable tool performs MRTR preflight/create-or-get.

rmcp persistent tasks remain application-owned: stock TaskManager/TaskContext have no storage backend injection, and the generic Tasks capability guard remains post-handler. The registered tool must capability-check before materialization and custom get/update/cancel must target the durable store.
